ai_summary: Amanta Healthcare Limited announced the immediate resignation of its Chief Operating Officer, Shri Anil Rathi, effective October 29, 2026. While the stated reason is "better opportunity and growth," the abrupt nature of the departure, tendered via a personal email and with immediate effect, is a significant red flag that could signal underlying operational or internal issues and creates a critical leadership void. This sudden exit of a key senior management personnel may lead to operational disruptions requiring immediate attention.
